# Psalm 117 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise YHWH all nations; extol-him all the-peoples.

**2** For has-prevailed over-us his-steadfast-love, and-faithfulness-of YHWH to-forever. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **117:1-2**: The shortest psalm — and the shortest chapter in the Bible. Two verses, yet it calls all nations (goyim) and all peoples to praise YHWH. Maximum universality in minimum space.

— EMET
